calculation_notes: TTM = FY2025 + 9M FY2026 - 9M FY2025; no quarter annualization.
Mechanical OCF-minus-capex is not normalized owner FCF because litigation payments, client-incentive timing, taxes and settlement working capital affect cash flow.

Normalized owner cash range is bounded by GAAP net income + D&A - capex and TTM non-GAAP net income adjusted for recurring capital intensity; SBC remains a real compensation expense and is not added back separately in the central owner-cash estimate.

Market capitalization uses Q3 diluted A-equivalent share count as a practical valuation denominator; Visa's multiple share classes and retrospective responsibility conversions make simple period-end Class A shares incomplete.
Adjusted operating margin proxy equals net revenue minus disclosed non-GAAP operating expenses divided by net revenue; it is a diagnostic, not a company-defined margin metric.
